caption: Did you know that GLP-1 helps regulate your appetite? 🍴💡 GLP-1 is a hormone that promotes feelings of fullness, reducing hunger and calorie intake. 💪 Research shows that GLP-1 analogs can aid in weight management. 📊 Here are 5 key facts about GLP-1 and satiety signaling: 1) GLP-1 is secreted in response to food intake, 2) it slows gastric emptying, 3) GLP-1 reduces glucose production in the liver, 4) it increases insulin sensitivity, and 5) GLP-1 analogs can help with weight loss. 🌟 Save this so you don't lose it.
